title: Everest vs Earth vs ISS vs Sun: Mind-Blowing Size Comparison #Shorts
description:
Mount Everest is 8.8 km tall. Earth is 12,742 km wide. The ISS flies just 400 km above us. And the Sun? 109 Earths fit across it and 1.3 million fit inside. Zoom out and feel the scale.
